description: 全國土壤及地下水污染場址筆數及面積統計 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 環境部環境管理署. 提供全國各縣市污染場址（包含地下水受污染限制使用地區、控制場址與整治場址）之數量與面積統計情形. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 環境部環境管理署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
